gen-eater-gf-onest: Gothic and jagged, Eater draws thin strokes against weightier stems, with wide gaps between letters. Onest, a plain sans, keeps its line gently uniform, so paragraphs feel friendly.
gen-flavors-gf-numans: Flavors towers with a stubby, pencil-stroke x-height, its diagonals as hefty as its stems. And Numans, a plain sans with generously tracked letters and far-flung s ends, gives it a level, quiet foil.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-orienta: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, its c tips never drifting toward touching, with little gap between capitals and lowercase. Orienta's open sans-serif forms take a modest size.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Rounded forms stay clearly open to the side in Noto Sans Old Permic, with lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Noto Sans Old Permic would read in a plain, approachable way beneath Audiowide's tile-like, hairline-free glyphs.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-malaya: Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut, giving it an ornate, literary air. But Noto Sans Malayalam handles the daily work, its plain sans middle zone dominating each line and its s opening generously.
gen-eater-gf-parkinsans: Dark and snarling. Eater pairs hairline-free thin strokes with weightier stems, while Parkinsans, a sans-serif, keeps one ruler-straight line weight and crisp, wide-mouthed letters even when shrunk.
gen-flavors-gf-oxygen: Squeezed-toothpaste lines and a towering x-height make Flavors whimsical, with diagonals as hefty as stems. And Oxygen, a plain sans with curves left open, lets Flavors earn its keep big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-pathway-extreme: Autour One traces each round letter with a laser-etched, constant-width line and a clear channel leading in, barely stepping from capital to lowercase. Pathway Extreme, a sans-serif, adds a big x-height with stubby ascenders.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens its letters like a pried oyster shell, under a lofty x-height that reads modern and clear. And Funnel Display does expressive, commanding work, its tails and terminals as thick as stems.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Wide-mouthed letters and a tall x-height reaching almost to cap height make Noto Sans Old Sogdian stay crisp, even when shrunk. Audiowide brings futuristic, tile-like glyphs; its stems and arcs move in lockstep.
